mentions.name: Atlas Operator
mentions.description: Autonomous agent that manages business operations, currently focused on email triage and content distribution. Includes a free 5-step inbox reset system that founders can complete in 60 minutes, with the stated challenge of making agents productive enough to be worth running 24/7.
